title: The Soul Who Sins Shall Die

questions.question: What proverb were the people of Israel using concerning the land of Israel?
options: "The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge."
"A city without walls is like an eagle without wings."
"The Lord has forsaken the earth."
"Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost."
questions.correctAnswer: "The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:2 (ESV): "What do you mean by repeating this proverb concerning the land of Israel, 'The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge'?"

questions.question: What did the Lord promise regarding this proverb?
options: "You shall no more use this proverb in Israel."
"It shall be written in your hearts."
"I will make it a reality unto the third generation."
"You shall teach it to your children."
questions.correctAnswer: "You shall no more use this proverb in Israel."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:3 (ESV): "As I live, declares the Lord God, this proverb shall no more be used by you in Israel."

questions.question: God declares: "Behold, all souls are mine; the soul of the father as well as the soul of the son is mine: the soul who... shall die."
options: Sins
Rebels
Forgets
Sleeps
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:4 (ESV): "Behold, all souls are mine; the soul of the father as well as the soul of the son is mine: the soul who sins shall die."

questions.question: If a man is righteous, what will be his reward according to Ezekiel 18:9?
options: "He walks in my statutes, and keeps my rules by acting faithfully—he is righteous; he shall surely live, declares the Lord God."
He will be given a long life with many children
He will be made a king in Israel
He will not be touched by the sword
questions.correctAnswer: "He walks in my statutes, and keeps my rules by acting faithfully—he is righteous; he shall surely live, declares the Lord God."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:9 (ESV): "walks in my statutes, and keeps my rules by acting faithfully—he is righteous; he shall surely live, declares the Lord God."

questions.question: If a righteous man fathers a son who is violent, a shedder of blood, and does not do any of his father's duties but does all these abominations, what is the son's fate?
options: He shall not live; he has done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon himself
He will be saved by the righteousness of his father
He will be sent into exile to repent
He shall be cleansed by fire
questions.correctAnswer: He shall not live; he has done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon himself
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:13 (ESV): "lends at discount, and takes advance; shall he then live? He shall not live. He has done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon himself."

questions.question: If this violent son then fathers a son who sees all his father's sins, but considers and does not do likewise, what is the grandson's fate?
options: He shall not die for his father's iniquity; he shall surely live
He shall bear some of his father's guilt
He must offer a sacrifice of atonement for his father
He shall be tested by fire
questions.correctAnswer: He shall not die for his father's iniquity; he shall surely live
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:17 (ESV): "withholds his hand from iniquity, takes no discount or advance, keeps my rules, and walks in my statutes; he shall not die for his father's iniquity; he shall surely live."

questions.question: What happens to the wicked father?
options: Because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what is not good among his people, behold, he shall die for his iniquity
He is forgiven because of his righteous son
He is exiled completely
He is struck blind
questions.correctAnswer: Because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what is not good among his people, behold, he shall die for his iniquity
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:18 (ESV): "As for his father, because he practiced extortion, robbed his brother, and did what is not good among his people, behold, he shall die for his iniquity."

questions.question: The people asked, "Why should not the son suffer for the iniquity of the father?" God replied: "When the son has done what is just and right... he shall surely..."
options: Live
Prosper
Be blessed
Prevail
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:19 (ESV): "When the son has done what is just and right, and has been careful to observe all my statutes, he shall surely live."

questions.question: If a wicked person turns away from all his sins that he has committed and keeps all God's statutes, what is the promise?
options: He shall surely live; he shall not die
He will be forgiven, but still must suffer the consequences
He will be placed on trial again
He must perform penance for his whole life
questions.correctAnswer: He shall surely live; he shall not die
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:21 (ESV): "But if a wicked person turns away from all his sins that he has committed and keeps all my statutes and does what is just and right, he shall surely live; he shall not die."

questions.question: What memorable question does God ask concerning the death of the wicked?
options: "Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked, declares the Lord God, and not rather that he should turn from his way and live?"
"Who will mourn for the wicked when they die?"
"Can the wicked escape the sword?"
"Does the grave satisfy their hunger?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked, declares the Lord God, and not rather that he should turn from his way and live?"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:23 (ESV): "Have I any pleasure in the death of the wicked, declares the Lord God, and not rather that he should turn from his way and live?"

questions.question: What happens if a righteous person turns away from his righteousness and commits injustice and does the same abominations that the wicked person does?
options: None of the righteous deeds that he has done shall be remembered; for the treachery of which he is guilty and the sin he has committed, he shall die
His past righteousness will lessen his punishment
He will be warned three times before judgment
God will restore his heart eventually
questions.correctAnswer: None of the righteous deeds that he has done shall be remembered; for the treachery of which he is guilty and the sin he has committed, he shall die
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:24 (ESV): "None of the righteous deeds that he has done shall be remembered; for the treachery of which he is guilty and the sin he has committed, he shall die."

questions.question: What does the house of Israel complain about regarding God's way of judging?
options: "The way of the Lord is not just."
"The way of the Lord is too hard."
"The Lord judges blindly."
"The Lord delays His coming."
questions.correctAnswer: "The way of the Lord is not just."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:25 (ESV): "Yet you say, 'The way of the Lord is not just.' Hear now, O house of Israel: Is my way not just? Is it not your ways that are not just?"

questions.question: God says He will judge the house of Israel, everyone according to what?
options: His ways
His lineage
His offerings
His wealth
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:30 (ESV): "Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, declares the Lord God."

questions.question: What command does God give to the people so that iniquity will not be their ruin?
options: "Repent and turn from all your transgressions, lest iniquity be your ruin."
"Fast for three days and three nights."
"Tear down the high places immediately."
"Offer sacrifices of bulls and goats."
questions.correctAnswer: "Repent and turn from all your transgressions, lest iniquity be your ruin."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:30 (ESV): "Repent and turn from all your transgressions, lest iniquity be your ruin."

questions.question: What does God command them to make for themselves?
options: "Make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit!"
"Make yourselves a walled defense!"
"Make yourselves an altar of unhewn stone!"
"Make yourselves a sanctuary of peace!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit!"
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 18:31 (ESV): "Cast away from you all the transgressions that you have committed, and make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit! Why will you die, O house of Israel?"

key_verse_text: "For I have no pleasure in the death of anyone, declares the Lord God; so turn, and live."
